title: Monthly Platform Fee Debit for Completed Billing Months — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Billing Tool Reference
content:
## The platform fee of a completed billing month

This rule settles the platform fee of a completed billing month of a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service, the calendar month before the month of the fee debit day. For a billing month that ended while the service was open, the platform fee is debited on the tier's fee debit business day of the following month and is worked out under this rule; the platform fee of the month in which a service closes is not set here, and is debited on the day the closure is taken under the rule for the closing month.

The platform fee of a completed billing month is billed under the tier the service holds on its fee debit day, and only that fee; every other fee, the platform fee of the month in which a service closes included, is debited from the prefund balance under the tier held on the day it is incurred.

The fee falls due on the fee debit day for each billing month that ended while the service was open.

## Debiting the fee

The fee is debited with `debit_platform_fee_9215b300`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Capability.** It debits the platform fee of the calendar month before the current one from an employer's Instant Pay Disbursement service, as the fee of that completed billing month. One call books one platform fee entry for that billing month on the service's ledger, pointing to no other entry, and lowers the service's prefund balance by the amount; the employer sees the fee on its ledger at once. An amount that is not greater than zero, or a fee kind or source other than those described below, books nothing and is reported back.

### Parameters

- `disburse_service_id` — the reference number of the employer's Instant Pay Disbursement service, read from the service record returned by the service lookup (identifier).
- `fee_type` — exactly `monthly_platform`: the platform fee of a completed billing month, the only kind of fee this tool books.
- `related_entry_id` — the reference number of the ledger entry the fee arises from; a platform fee arises from no ledger entry, so it is passed as an empty string.
- `amount` — the platform fee to debit for the completed month, in US dollars as a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places; a value with more decimals is rounded half up to the cent before booking.

### Return

- A one-line confirmation naming the new ledger entry reference (text), the service reference (text), the billing month (YYYY-MM, the month before the current one), the amount debited (US dollars, two decimals) and the prefund balance after the debit (US dollars, two decimals). The entry reference being present means the fee was booked.
- A message beginning "Not booked" means the amount, fee kind or source was not accepted and nothing changed.

### Contract illustration (hypothetical values)

A call made in any month with `fee_type` `monthly_platform`, an empty `related_entry_id` and an `amount` of 12.345 books 12.35 for the previous calendar month; an `amount` of 0, another fee kind or a named source entry returns a message beginning "Not booked".
